sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A rhizomatous perennial spurge, 10–50 cm tall. It colonizes fields, roadsides and disturbed ground.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: Its narrow leaves are about 5–30 × 0.5–3 mm. The cyathia are surrounded by yellow-green bracts; the small capsule is about 2.5–4 mm long.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The sap can irritate skin and eyes; all parts are toxic if swallowed. Like the other spurges in these entries, it is not for consumption.
